item.title: Bone and Biscuit Best Buddy – Feb 4 – Floofers and Ewok
item.description: Meet Floofers and Ewok, two inseparable brothers and the last of their litter to find a family of their own. These boys have been bonded since day one and must be adopted together. They are never far apart, always seeking each other out for playtime and snuggles, and if one is out of sight the other will call out until they’re back together again.
